extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors interested in Netflix original programming
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia list article that compiles Netflix 'original' television series and related specials that are considered to have ended, organized by genre and including key metadata for each entry. The page defines inclusion rules and the table/column structure used for each listed show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion criterion — Netflix Originals that have ended
rubrics_metrics.description: These shows are worldwide or regional Netflix Originals and have either completed their runs or Netflix stopped producing episodes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A show is also assumed to have ended if there has been no confirmed news of renewal at least one year after the show's last episode was released.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope boundaries / exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: This article is about ended Netflix original series and related specials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For current and upcoming Netflix original series and related specials, see the separate 'List of Netflix original programming'. For Netflix original stand-up comedy specials, see 'List of Netflix original stand-up comedy specials'. For Netflix original films, see 'Lists of Netflix original films'. For Netflix exclusive international distribution TV shows, see 'Lists of Netflix exclusive international distribution programming'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required table/entry fields for each listed show
rubrics_metrics.description: Each show entry is presented with the following columns: Title; Genre; Premiere; Finale; Seasons; Runtime; Notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These columns are repeated across the genre sections (Drama, Comedy, Kids & family, Animation, Anime, etc.) and represent the metadata expected for each listed program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization by genre/section
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows are grouped under genre headings (for example: Drama; Comedy; Kids & family; Animation; Anime; Adult animation; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The genre-based sections structure the list and determine where a given show should be placed; multi-genre shows appear under the most appropriate heading(s) used on the page.
